people_visible: father, mother, older daughter, newborn
event: Hospital - first moments as four
notes: Black and white, hospital bed, all four together for the first time. Emotionally the strongest frame so far - the literal one-became-four beat.

people_visible: father, mother, newborn
event: Hospital - birth of first daughter
notes: Hospital room, newborn in arms, both parents beaming. Irreplaceable - the exact hinge from couple to family. Chapter 4 opener.

people_visible: father, mother, newborn
event: Hospital - birth of second daughter
notes: Second birth. Pairs directly with D001 - same framing, three years on.

people_visible: young couple
event: He lifts her off the ground indoors
notes: He has swept her off her feet mid-laugh in a student room. Unguarded and young - one of the best possible openings for Chapter 1.

people_visible: Father in a 'my favorite people call me dad' shirt and mother in a pink tie-dye top, both in purple face masks, leaning over a newborn strapped into an infant car seat
event: Discharge day at the hospital, the parents with their newborn daughter buckled into her car seat, ready to go home
theme: Becoming parents; Family growth; Parenthood; Milestones; Family of five
notes: The going-home frame: hospital bed, infant car seat with a bow-wrapped newborn, both parents masked. The masks date it to the pandemic and the shirt is the same one worn in other hospital arrivals.

people_visible: The father in an academic gown and hood with the mother in a black dress
event: His graduation - a banner above them reads 'CONGRATULATIONS, GRADUATES' beneath a large ornamental clock, with balloon arches in the background
notes: COUPLE ALONE at his graduation with the ceremony banner readable in frame - the single biggest documented milestone in this batch. Black-and-white print, scanned upside down, but sharp and beautifully composed.

people_visible: The mother in a black one-piece swimsuit and the father in a straw fedora, sunglasses and blue board shorts
event: Standing together in shallow turquoise water with the Atlantis Paradise Island Royal Towers directly behind them - the Bahamas
theme: Vacations; Marriage; Adventure; The life we built
notes: COUPLE ALONE at Atlantis in the Bahamas, with the resort clearly identifiable - very likely the honeymoon, though nothing in the frame proves it outright. Sharp, bright and the best-looking print of the later era.

people_visible: The two daughters seen from behind with their hands pressed against a glass storm door, an older grey-haired man standing outside on the walkway holding something out toward them
event: A visit conducted through a closed glass door - the girls at the glass, an older relative kept outside on the path
theme: Family growth; Home; Growing older; The life we built
notes: Late March 2020 and a doorway visit with the glass between them - the single most historically specific frame in this batch. The girls' small hands flat on the door do all the work; shot from inside so they are silhouetted.

people_visible: The father in a pink shirt walking away from camera at dusk carrying the youngest daughter on his hip, holding the middle daughter's hand, with the eldest in a white dress walking ahead
event: Walking back along a marina dock at dusk after dinner, all seen from behind
theme: Fatherhood; Vacations; Parenthood; The life we built
notes: Backs-turned dusk frame of a father hauling one daughter, leading another by the hand and following the third — motion-blurred and dark, but it carries more than any posed shot on the sheet.

people_visible: The father seated indoors, laughing, with dozens of small jewel stickers stuck all over his bald head and face; a daughter's hands are reaching in to place more, and the mother stands beside him
event: The girls decorating dad's bald head with rhinestone stickers while he sits and takes it
notes: Completely unrepeatable: dad's shaved head covered in gem stickers, hands still working on him, everyone laughing. Indoor light is mediocre and it doesn't matter.

people_visible: All three daughters photographed from behind on a grass field, wearing teal team jerseys with the family surname and numbers 5, 11 and 4
event: The three sisters standing together on the field in their team jerseys, backs to the camera
theme: Sports; Sisterhood; Family of five; The life we built; Growing together
notes: All three girls in the same surname on their backs, tallest to smallest, facing the field they all play on. Anonymous faces make it universal — the single best summary frame of where this family has arrived.

people_visible: The father (shaved head) sitting propped against a tufted headboard reading aloud from a purple folder, with three daughters piled against him — one small girl in his lap, one tucked under each arm
event: Father reading aloud to all three daughters on a bed
theme: Fatherhood; Parenthood; Everyday life; Family of five
notes: All three girls are physically draped over their father while he reads — the whole family-of-five dynamic in one unposed frame. Slightly soft and casually framed, but the closeness is real.

people_visible: Father standing chest-deep in clear turquoise water with both arms raised, the three daughters hanging off him and floating around him
event: Playing in the sea, the father hoisting all three girls at once
theme: Fatherhood; Vacations; Humor; Family of five
notes: Arms up in triumph with a daughter clamped to each side and the youngest floating in front in pink armbands — genuine, physical joy. Bright water, clean exposure, holds the screen easily.

people_visible: The couple kissing on a patterned sofa; he in a white vest and navy backwards cap, she in a white t-shirt leaning into him
event: A quiet kiss on the sofa of a wood-panelled cabin or lake house
notes: The single most intimate frame in the batch: the two of them alone, mid-kiss, no audience, warm afternoon light through the curtain. Same weekend as S027, S028 and S029.

people_visible: Father in the foreground taking the selfie, mother behind, and all three daughters, everyone in Christmas pyjamas
event: Christmas pyjama selfie sprawled on the floor of the playroom among toys and a ball pit
theme: Family of five; Holidays; Home; Sisterhood; The life we built
notes: All five of them piled together on the playroom floor in holiday pyjamas, every single face genuinely smiling and the toddler in the middle laughing straight down the lens. Grainy low indoor light does nothing to hurt it.

people_visible: mother, older daughter, newborn, father
event: Older sister meeting the baby
notes: Shot from behind the older girl - unposed, quiet. Imperfect framing but a real moment.

people_visible: All three daughters, in matching black lacrosse pinnies numbered 5, 11 and 4 with the family surname across the back, looking back over their shoulders
event: The three sisters standing together at the edge of a large open grass lacrosse field, turned to look back at the camera
theme: Sisterhood; Sports; Growing older; Growing together
notes: Black-and-white frame of the three sisters in identical family-name jerseys, tallest to smallest, glancing back across a huge empty field. It reads as one image of the whole sibling set and of the sport that runs through this stretch of the archive.

people_visible: The couple kissing, lying down; her hair falling across his face, a small ring visible on her right hand resting on his shoulder
event: A kiss on the floor at a party - a Coors/Bud Light can, a blue balloon and drum hardware are right beside them
notes: A completely private moment caught in the middle of a party - the couple alone, kissing, oblivious. Blown-out flash and grain, but the emotion carries it. Same night as S031.

people_visible: The father with snow on his shaved head and the mother in a fur-trimmed hood
event: The two of them outdoors in falling snow at night, cheek to cheek, string lights behind
notes: COUPLE ALONE in a snowstorm, both laughing with snow visibly on his head - the most joyful frame on sheet 5. Flash-lit snowflakes cause hot spots but add to it.

people_visible: father, mother
event: Outdoor event/festival
notes: Sunglasses, cheek to cheek, crowd behind. Rare post-kids photo of just the two of them looking like themselves. Prime closing-sequence material.

people_visible: mother, father and two daughters crowded into a close outdoor selfie
event: an arm's-length family selfie in a park, everyone laughing into the lens
theme: Parenthood; Growing together; The life we built; Everyday life
notes: Four faces filling the frame, all four genuinely laughing - the warmest frame in this batch. Bright natural light and sharp faces despite the selfie distortion.

people_visible: young couple
event: She kisses his cheek indoors
notes: She leans in to kiss his cheek while he grins at the camera. Tender and very young.

people_visible: young couple
event: Poolside/deck, he kisses her
notes: A kiss on a sunlit deck, drink in her hand. Precisely dated May 2007 - eight days after S067, so likely the same trip.

people_visible: Father in sunglasses in a low-angle selfie with all three daughters piled around him; the youngest drinking from a cup, one girl in a 'Best Sister' shirt
event: Sitting outside together, the girls crowding into a selfie
notes: Four faces stacked at different depths and none of them arranged — the toddler drinks straight through the photo and the eldest leans in laughing. Messy, warm and unrepeatable.

people_visible: The couple, both in formal dress: she in a blue halter gown with an updo, he in a pale blue-grey formal suit with a white boutonniere
event: Posed portrait before a school formal / prom, in a living room in front of a floral upholstered chair
notes: The earliest hard-dated picture of the two of them together in this batch, and the only formal-dress portrait of them as teenagers. The stamp '00. 5.10' predates the 2003 start date given in the brief, so this pair evidently goes back to high school.

people_visible: father, mother, toddler daughter
event: Outdoors, overcast
notes: Tight three-head crop, all genuinely laughing. One of the warmest family-of-three frames in the archive.

people_visible: father, older daughter, newborn
event: At home on the couch
notes: Dad holds the newborn while the big sister holds her doll in the same pose. Accidental and lovely.

people_visible: The two daughters standing arm in arm on a wet driveway in first-day outfits, one holding a name card
event: First day of school, the sisters hugging before leaving
notes: Black and white on a rain-dark driveway, older sister's arm around the younger one - a clean marker of a school-year transition. Part of a four-photo first-day sequence taken that morning.

people_visible: Mother visibly pregnant in a floral swimsuit, father in blue trunks, and two daughters (one held on his hip, one standing in front)
event: Beach portrait late in the third pregnancy
theme: Family growth; Becoming parents; Vacations; Family of four
notes: The clearest 'family of four, about to be five' frame in the batch: the bump is unmistakable and both older girls are in the shot. A natural hinge point in the documentary.

people_visible: The couple lying on a carpeted floor among confetti and beer cans, heads together, laughing
event: The aftermath of a party - streamers and confetti all over the carpet, drum hardware and cymbal stands in the corner, cans on the side table
notes: Collapsed on the floor at the end of a party, still holding on to each other and laughing - the debris around them tells the whole story of the night. Same party as S049.

people_visible: young couple
event: In the water in front of the Atlantis resort, Bahamas
notes: Standing in turquoise water with Atlantis behind. A strong candidate for the honeymoon or a major early trip - worth confirming which.

people_visible: The father in sunglasses and the mother, both in the sea
event: The two of them swimming together in clear turquoise ocean, heads and shoulders above water
notes: COUPLE ALONE in the ocean, both laughing - gorgeous water colour and one of the most joyful, filmic frames here. Strong hero candidate.

people_visible: visibly pregnant mother in a swimsuit sitting on a boat bench with a small child in a life jacket beside her
event: on a pontoon boat on a lake during pregnancy, a toddler in a life vest tucked against her
theme: Becoming parents; Family growth; Motherhood; Vacations
notes: A rare pregnancy frame - bare bump, life jacket, lake water behind - documenting a family about to grow again. Soft, slightly blown-out phone capture, but almost nothing else in the archive shows a pregnancy.

people_visible: The three daughters kneeling and lying in a pile on white sand at dusk, in swimsuits, laughing toward the camera
event: The three sisters playing in the sand at last light with the resort and palms behind them
notes: Wide, quiet dusk frame: three sisters tangled together on empty sand under a pastel sky and palm silhouettes. Composition and light both hold up for a long screen hold.

people_visible: The couple on the cabin sofa; he in a black beanie and white t-shirt, she in a pale blue sweatshirt, each holding a glass of red wine
event: Toasting with wine glasses in the cabin living room
notes: A wine toast, just the two of them, in a borrowed cabin - reads as one of their first trips away together. Print is slightly crooked with the curtain dominating the top third.

people_visible: father, daughter
event: Backyard
notes: Dad sprawled in a lawn chair, daughter in a tiny chair copying his exact pose. Genuinely funny - Chapter 5.

people_visible: Mother lying on the floor with an infant in a 'Milk Monster' onesie on her chest and two older daughters in Halloween costumes stretched out on either side
event: Halloween on the living room floor with the new baby
theme: Holidays; Motherhood; Family growth; Family of five
notes: Shot from directly overhead with all four laid out in a row on the rug — the newborn's first Halloween, in costume, with her sisters. The bird's-eye framing is unlike anything else in the batch.

people_visible: mother in a long strapless patterned gown and father in a grey suit, standing on a balcony above a river valley
event: dressed for a wedding or formal event, posing on the venue balcony - COUPLE ALONE
theme: Marriage; Growing together; Growing older; The life we built
notes: COUPLE ALONE and formally dressed - a rare grown-up frame of the two of them away from the children, with a river valley behind. Slightly distant framing but the setting and outfits make it a natural closing image.

people_visible: The father and the youngest daughter side by side, both sticking their tongues out and crossing their eyes for the camera, in a busy shop or ice-cream counter
event: Silly face-pulling selfie with a striped drink cup on the counter beside them
theme: Humor; Fatherhood; Everyday life; Growing together
notes: Father and daughter pulling identical goofy faces, tongues out — the mirroring is the whole point and it lands. Busy background, but the two of them dominate.

people_visible: Close-up of one daughter in red plaid pajamas with her mouth wide open in surprise, an adult in a Christmas sweater seated beside her at the edge of frame
event: Reacting to a gift on Christmas Eve — caught mid-gasp
notes: Pure unguarded reaction shot: eyes wide, mouth open, caught the exact instant. Indoor light is warm and slightly soft but the expression carries it.
